aboutShowcase.heading: We Transform Ideas Into Working Software
aboutShowcase.body: MubarmiJ is a software studio that helps small and medium businesses across Egypt and the Gulf grow through technology. We deliver structured automation, modern web platforms and mobile apps with a hands-on, transparent process.
aboutShowcase.f1Body: Every project is shaped around a clear business outcome — leads, hours saved, conversion lift — not a wishlist of features.
aboutShowcase.f2Body: You work directly with experienced developers who have shipped automation, web and mobile products in production for years.
aboutShowcase.f3Body: Modern stacks, clean code and ownership of the source means your platform keeps growing long after launch — no lock-in.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: MubarmiJ ("we", "us", "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you visit mubarmijonline.com or contact us, how we use it, and the choices you have.
privacyPage.s1: MubarmiJ is a software studio based in Cairo, Egypt, providing process automation, web development and mobile app services to small and medium businesses across Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. You can reach us at info@mubarmijonline.com or +20 120 058 8803.
privacyPage.s2: We only collect information you choose to give us — your name, email, phone number and any message details you submit through our contact, lead-magnet or newsletter forms. We also collect basic, non-identifying technical data (browser, device type, pages viewed, referrer) through privacy-friendly analytics so we can improve the website.
privacyPage.s3: We use submitted contact details only to (a) reply to your enquiry, (b) deliver the free guide or resource you requested, (c) follow up about a project we are actively discussing, or (d) send our newsletter if you opted in. We never sell your data.
privacyPage.s4: We use a small number of cookies and pixels (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Microsoft Clarity, LinkedIn Insight) to measure marketing performance and improve the site. You can disable these in your browser settings at any time without affecting site functionality.
privacyPage.s5: We share data only with the service providers needed to operate the site (hosting, email delivery, analytics, CRM). These providers are bound by their own privacy commitments and only process data on our behalf.
privacyPage.s6: We keep contact and lead information for as long as needed to serve your request and our legitimate business interests, then delete it. You can request deletion at any time.
privacyPage.s7: You can ask us to access, correct, export or delete the personal data we hold about you, or unsubscribe from any marketing email. Email info@mubarmijonline.com and we will respond within 30 days.
privacyPage.s8: We use HTTPS across the site and limit access to personal data to the staff who need it. No system is 100% secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your information.
privacyPage.s9: Our services are not directed to children under 16 and we do not knowingly collect data from them.
privacyPage.s10: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on this page with a new "last updated" date.
